disclaimer: Paper-only, educational. Odds-backed market-implied World Cup projections from The Odds API; no API-Football stat/lineup/xG layer.
methodology: Per market: de-vig the sportsbook price (3-way for moneyline/double chance). No independent stat model — confidence capped, model edge ~0 except where the double-chance book price differs from the 3-way no-vig sum.
